name: Irene. The Window
source:
Irene. The Window is a cozy and innovative narrative game about chatting with an old friend, doing things in real life, and dealing with hard truths.

A self-dubbed IRL video call simulator, the game combines a branching visual novel experience with real-life tasks that promote healthy habits as well as help with anxiety and internet addiction. Also, it's fun.

The game’s flexible structure allows the player to pursue romance or just have a good time with a friend, lean into the real-life content or skip it altogether.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484890/Irene_The_Window/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
艾琳. 《The Window》是一款舒适且创新的叙事游戏，讲述与老朋友聊天、在现实生活中做事以及处理残酷的事实。

该游戏自称为IRL视频通话模拟器，将分支视觉小说体验与现实生活中的任务结合起来，促进健康习惯并帮助缓解焦虑和网络成瘾。而且，这很有趣。

该游戏灵活的结构允许玩家追求浪漫或只是与朋友共度美好时光，专注于现实生活的内容或完全跳过它。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484890/Irene_The_Window/]Steam[/url]]
